about_the_game:
Design the perfect automated defense system for the city in this physics-based game. Destroy the falling celestial objects with turrets, fire, lightning, portals, and more! Each level will challenge your ingenuity and creativity.

Falling Stars is a building puzzle game where players design the automatic defense system of a city to protect it from falling celestial objects. It's a mix between a tower defense and a puzzle game, with physics that resembles a pinball machine.

This Demo contains one world made of 10 levels.

The full game will contain:

Four different worlds with different gimmics

Each new level will bring new challenges, and the designs to pass them will need to be more complex. Each new world will add a new object you can build that will add a new mechanic and a new way of challenging you.

Infinite solutions.

Our puzzles can be solved in infinite ways since they encourage players' creativity. You can create an efficient and clean solution or a messy and overengineered one. The sky is the limit!

Physics are fun!

Sit back and watch the chaos produced by the objects falling, bouncing, and exploding!

Rethink, iterate, and optimize.

You can modify your buildings endlessly until you reach your perfect design. All levels will save your solution so you can always come back and tinker with them at any moment.

Additional challenges.

Each level will have optional additional challenges that will test your ability to find an optimal solution for that city. They will limit your budget, the number of buildings you can place and force you not to let any object fall into the city.
